name: Aria
source:
Aria is the protagonist of this story. 
About two years ago, a couple of merchants found her half-dead and uncouscious on a little-used road. She survived but has no memories of her past nor of her true identity. She just remember than somebody attempted to kill her before she was found half-dead by the merchants.

Aria is not her real name. She took it only because it's one of the most popular female names around Emeroth Kindom. It was a perfectly suitable name for someone who wants to keep a low profile. A someone who feared of her mysterious would-be assassin.

She lives now in a small tavern and works there as a waitress for a very low salary.
